# Popol Vuh — QUESTIONS

(Decisions the conventions do not settle, with what was decided meanwhile.)

- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-002 (reviewer's flags, nothing blocked): (1) Brasseur reads g (= ꜫ) in poco / poc / pocotahic, which the established text prints with plain c; the establishment log does not discuss it. Kept as established; the establisher of later parts should look at this letter. (2) The published glossary entry `chauaxoc` gives the root as chaw 'sow', which conflicts with `ravaxic` (awax 'sow'); left unchanged, as it belongs to the pilot's entries. (3) Xuculu (unit 33) is left untranslated in the English as well, its meaning unknown; decided meanwhile to keep it so.
- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-003 (establish): images 0017 and 0018 in source/pages are blank; the text continues from the last line of 0016 directly onto 0019 (checked against Brasseur, nothing missing). Decided meanwhile: 003 ends on 0019 line 3 (`xcute qui vach.`), and popol-vuh-004 (parts.json says images 0018–0020) begins at 0019 line 3 and should read on into 0021 if needed. The folio of 0019 is taken as 5r (blank leaves assumed unfoliated). The owner may want to check whether the LoC originals at 0017–0018 are truly blank leaves. Also: this text prints `Ah Raxa Lac` with plain c as the image shows, where the pilot printed `Laꜫ`; left both as read.
- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-003 (draft; nothing blocked): (1) unit 13: the established text reads `Vꜩ are chuxoc` where Brasseur prints `Utz are ch'uxic`; the establishment log is silent. Kept as established, Brasseur's reading given in the note; the image (0015/0016) should be rechecked at this word. (2) `quech` is read here as kech 'of them', where the glossary (from 002) had 'ours'; the entry is broadened, not replaced. (3) `chu rico` is rendered passive ('let it be found') as in published 002, though the form is active; kept for consistency, and both parts may want revising together. (4) Ah Raxa Lac is printed with plain c as the image shows; the toggle shows Laq as in the pilot (which printed Laꜫ).
- 2026-11-24 · popol-vuh-004 (establish; nothing blocked): (1) Folios: the crops of images 0014, 0016, 0020 and 0022 carry a number (3, 4, 5, 6) at the top left of the K'iche' column, and 0019/0021 none. If these are recto folio numbers, 0016 = 4r, 0019 = 4v, 0020 = 5r, and every cite so far (from 0009 = 1r) is one page off. Decided meanwhile: keep the count the earlier parts use (004 = fols. 5r–6r); the owner may want to check the folio numbers against the full LoC page images. (2) 004 ends on image 0021 line 13 (`… rumal Ahꜯac, Ahbit.`), at the end of Vucub Caquix's boast, not at the foot of 0020 as parts.json planned; 005 begins at 0021 line 13 (`Vae v xe v chacatahic …`). (3) The first line of 0019, printed in 003 as `qui caa`, looks like `qui ꜫaa` (tresillo) in the image, the same letter this part prints in `ꜫaa` ×2; Brasseur reads `qui aq` there. Not changed (003 is published); noted for a later revision.
- 2026-11-24 · popol-vuh-004 (draft; nothing blocked): (1) the grindstone word (003 `caa`, 004 `ꜫaa`) is given mt kaa in both parts; the full modern form may be ka', and if so both parts should change together. The glossary entry `caa` still says "(uncertain)" while the new `ꜫaa` entry treats the word as certain. (2) `vinac ꜯac, vinac bit` is rendered plural ("the people built, the people shaped") in units 16, 20 and 25, where it refers to the wooden people already made; the house table gives the singular for the person still to be made (002). Kept meanwhile. (3) `cac chiquech` (unit 0) is left out of `i`, its meaning unknown (Brasseur: 'fowl'); `hule` (unit 20) likewise.
